info.title: Ambatuwork API v1
info.description: API documentation for Ambatuwork, a Scrum-based collaboration application used by Web and Android clients. Authenticate your requests using a Sanctum Bearer token.

post.summary: Exchange Google ID Token for API Token
post.description: Exchanges a Google ID token for a Sanctum API token. If the user doesn't exist, it creates a new user.

get.description: Returns the currently logged in user's details.

post.description: Revokes and deletes the current Sanctum token.

get.description: Returns all daily check-ins submitted during the specified sprint.

post.description: Submits a member's daily check-in. If the check-in contains blockers, an Impediment is automatically created.

get.description: Returns all impediments (blockers) for the specified project, newest first.

post.description: Creates a new impediment/blocker for the project. Automatically associates it with the active sprint if one exists.

patch.description: Updates an impediment's details or status.

get.description: Returns the peer review cycle details for the specified sprint.

404.description: Project, Sprint or Cycle not found

post.description: Creates and opens a peer review cycle for a sprint.
Submits a peer review for another user in the open cycle.
Closes an open peer review cycle.

get.description: Returns the full aggregated peer review summary for all active project members. Restricted to project owners.

get.summary: Get My Peer Review Summary (Anonymous & Aggregated)
get.description: Returns the current user's aggregated anonymous peer reviews.
Returns all non-archived backlog items for the project, ordered by priority rank.

post.description: Creates a new backlog item in the project.

get.description: Returns details of a single backlog item.

404.description: Project or Backlog Item not found

delete.description: Archives a backlog item by setting its status to archived.

404.description: Project or Backlog Item not found

patch.description: Updates backlog item details. All fields are optional.

404.description: Project or Backlog Item not found

get.description: Returns a list of active projects visible to the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new project. Also establishes the creator as the Owner and sets up a default Definition of Done.

get.description: Returns details of a single project visible to the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates project settings. All fields in request are optional.

get.description: Returns the active Definition of Done checklist for the specified project.

404.description: Project or Definition of Done not found

patch.summary: Create or Update Definition of Done
patch.description: Creates or updates the active Definition of Done checklist for the specified project.

get.description: Returns pending invitations addressed to the authenticated user's email.
Returns all pending invitations for the specified project.

post.description: Creates a pending invitation to join the project. The invitee is specified by email.
Accepts a project invitation using the plain token string.

get.description: Returns a list of all active members and supervisors in the specified project.

delete.description: Removes a member from the project. The owner cannot be removed.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User ID of the member to remove

422.description: Validation failed / Owner cannot be removed

patch.description: Updates a project member's role (e.g. from member to supervisor). The owner's role cannot be changed.

422.description: Validation failed / Owner role cannot be changed

get.description: Returns the retrospective details and feedback items for the specified sprint.

404.description: Project, Sprint or Retrospective not found

post.description: Submits or updates the overall team happiness score for a sprint retrospective.
Creates a feedback item (went well, to improve, or action item) for a sprint retrospective.

delete.description: Deletes a feedback item. Users can only delete their own items.

404.description: Project, Sprint or Item not found

patch.description: Updates a feedback item's body or details. Users can only update their own items.

404.description: Project, Sprint or Item not found

get.description: Returns the sprint board columns and items for the specified sprint.
Returns a list of all sprints associated with the specified project, newest first.

post.description: Creates a planned sprint and commits the selected backlog items into it. Only one active sprint is allowed per project.

get.description: Returns details of a single sprint.

post.description: Starts a planned sprint. The sprint must contain at least one backlog item and the project cannot already have an active sprint.
Closes an active sprint. Unfinished items are moved back to ready.

get.description: Returns the sprint review details for the specified sprint.

404.description: Project, Sprint or Review not found

post.description: Submits or updates the sprint review. Updates backlog item statuses based on the review decisions.
